035/**
036 * An simple list of HTTP parts (form-data, query-parameters, path-parameters).
037 *
038 * <h5 class='figure'>Example</h5>
039 * <p class='bjava'>
040 *    PartList <jv>parts</jv> = PartList
041 *       .<jsm>create</jsm>()
042 *       .append(MyPart.<jsm>of</jsm>(<js>"foo"</js>))
043 *       .append(<js>"Bar"</js>, ()-&gt;<jsm>getDynamicValueFromSomewhere</jsm>());
044 * </p>
045 *
046 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
047 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/JuneauRestCommon">juneau-rest-common Basics</a>
048 * </ul>
049 */
050@SuppressWarnings({
051   "java:S110",  // Inheritance depth acceptable for this class hierarchy
052   "java:S115",  // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase naming convention
053   "java:S2160"  // equals() inherited from ArrayList; list equality is element-based, which is correct for part lists
054})
055public class PartList extends ArrayList<NameValuePair> {

101   /**
102    * Creates a new {@link PartList} initialized with the specified name/value pairs.
103    *
104    * <h5 class='figure'>Example</h5>
105    * <p class='bjava'>
106    *    PartList <jv>parts</jv> = PartList.<jsm>ofPairs</jsm>(<js>"foo"</js>, 1, <js>"bar"</js>, <jk>true</jk>);
107    * </p>
108    *
109    * @param pairs
110    *    Initial list of pairs.
111    *    <br>Must be an even number of parameters representing key/value pairs.
112    * @throws RuntimeException If odd number of parameters were specified.
113    * @return A new instance.
114    */
115   public static PartList ofPairs(String...pairs) {
116      var x = new PartList();
117      if (pairs == null)
118         pairs = new String[0];
119      assertArg(pairs.length % 2 == 0, "Odd number of parameters passed into PartList.ofPairs()");
120      for (var i = 0; i < pairs.length; i += 2)
121         x.add(BasicPart.of(pairs[i], pairs[i + 1]));
122      return x;
123   }

249   /**
250    * Performs an action on all the matching parts in this list.
251    *
252    * <p>
253    * This is the preferred method for iterating over parts as it does not involve
254    * creation or copy of lists/arrays.
255    *
256    * @param filter A predicate to apply to each element to determine if it should be included.  Can be <jk>null</jk> (if <jk>null</jk>, all elements are accepted).
257    * @param action An action to perform on each element.
258    * @return This object.
259    */
260   public PartList forEach(Predicate<NameValuePair> filter, Consumer<NameValuePair> action) {
261      forEach(x -> consumeIf(filter, action, x));
262      return this;
263   }

271    *
272    * @param name The parts name.
273    * @param action An action to perform on each element.
274    * @return This object.
275    */
276   public PartList forEach(String name, Consumer<NameValuePair> action) {
277      return forEach(x -> eq(name, x.getName()), action);
278   }

284    * @param action An action to perform on each element.

286    */
287   public PartList forEachValue(Predicate<NameValuePair> filter, Consumer<String> action) {

302   /**
303    * Gets a part representing all of the part values with the given name.
304    *
305    * <p>
306    * Same as {@link #get(String, Class)} but the part name is pulled from the name or value attribute of the {@link FormData}/{@link Query}/{@link Path} annotation.
307    *
308    * <h5 class='figure'>Example</h5>
309    * <p class='bjava'>
310    *    Age <jv>age</jv> = <jv>partList</jv>.get(Age.<jk>class</jk>);
311    * </p>
312    *
313    * @param <T> The part implementation class.
314    * @param type The part implementation class.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
315    * @return A part with a condensed value, or an empty {@link Optional} if no parts by the given name are present.
316    */
317   public <T> Optional<T> get(Class<T> type) {
318      assertArgNotNull(ARG_type, type);
319
320      var name = PartBeanMeta.of(type).getSchema().getName();
321      assertArg(nn(name), "Part name could not be found on bean type '%s'", cn(type));
322
323      return get(name, type);
324   }
325
326   /**
327    * Gets a part representing all of the part values with the given name.
328    *
329    * <p>
330    * If more that one part with the given name exists the values will be combined with <js>", "</js> as per
331    * <a href='https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2616#section-4.2'>RFC 2616 Section 4.2</a>.
332    *
333    * @param name The part name.
334    * @return A part with a condensed value, or {@link Optional#empty()} if no parts by the given name are present
335    */
336   public Optional<NameValuePair> get(String name) {
337
338      NameValuePair first = null;
339      List<NameValuePair> rest = null;
340      for (var x : this) {
341         if (eq(x.getName(), name)) {
342            if (first == null)
343               first = x;
344            else {
345               if (rest == null)
346                  rest = list();
347               rest.add(x);
348            }
349         }
350      }
351
352      if (first == null)
353         return oe();
354
355      if (rest == null)
356         return o(first);
357
358      var sb = new CharArrayBuffer(128);
359      sb.append(first.getValue());
360      for (var element : rest) {
361         sb.append(',');
362         sb.append(element.getValue());
363      }
364
365      return o(new BasicStringPart(name, sb.toString()));
366   }
367
368   /**
369    * Gets a part representing all of the part values with the given name.
370    *
371    * <p>
372    * If more that one part with the given name exists the values will be combined with <js>", "</js> as per
373    * <a href='https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2616#section-4.2'>RFC 2616 Section 4.2</a>.
374    *
375    * <p>
376    * The implementation class must have a public constructor taking in one of the following argument lists:
377    * <ul>
378    *    <li><c>X(String <jv>value</jv>)</c>
379    *    <li><c>X(Object <jv>value</jv>)</c>
380    *    <li><c>X(String <jv>name</jv>, String <jv>value</jv>)</c>
381    *    <li><c>X(String <jv>name</jv>, Object <jv>value</jv>)</c>
382    * </ul>
383    *
384    * <h5 class='figure'>Example</h5>
385    * <p class='bjava'>
386    *    BasicIntegerPart <jv>age</jv> = <jv>partList</jv>.get(<js>"age"</js>, BasicIntegerPart.<jk>class</jk>);
387    * </p>
388    *
389    * @param <T> The part implementation class.
390    * @param name The part name.
391    * @param type The part implementation class.
392    * @return A part with a condensed value, or an empty {@link Optional} if no parts by the given name are present.
393    */
394   public <T> Optional<T> get(String name, Class<T> type) {
395
396      NameValuePair first = null;
397      List<NameValuePair> rest = null;
398      for (var x : this) {
399         if (eq(x.getName(), name)) {
400            if (first == null)
401               first = x;
402            else {
403               if (rest == null)
404                  rest = list();
405               rest.add(x);
406            }
407         }
408      }
409
410      if (first == null)
411         return oe();
412
413      if (rest == null)
414         return o(PartBeanMeta.of(type).construct(name, first.getValue()));
415
416      var sb = new CharArrayBuffer(128);
417      sb.append(first.getValue());
418      for (var element : rest) {
419         sb.append(',');
420         sb.append(element.getValue());
421      }
422
423      return o(PartBeanMeta.of(type).construct(name, sb.toString()));
424   }

426   /**
427    * Gets all of the parts.
428    *
429    * <p>
430    * The returned array maintains the relative order in which the parts were added.
431    * Each call creates a new array not backed by this list.
432    *
433    * <p>
434    * As a general rule, it's more efficient to use the other methods with consumers to
435    * get parts.
436    *
437    * @return An array containing all parts, never <jk>null</jk>.
438    */
439   public NameValuePair[] getAll() { return stream().toArray(NameValuePair[]::new); }
440
441   /**
442    * Gets all of the parts with the given name.
443    *
444    * <p>
445    * The returned array maintains the relative order in which the parts were added.
446    * Part name comparison is case sensitive by default.
447    * Parts with null values are ignored.
448    * Each call creates a new array not backed by this list.
449    *
450    * <p>
451    * As a general rule, it's more efficient to use the other methods with consumers to
452    * get parts.
453    *
454    * @param name The part name.
455    *
456    * @return An array containing all matching parts, never <jk>null</jk>.
457    */
458   public NameValuePair[] getAll(String name) {
459      return stream().filter(x -> eq(x.getName(), name)).toArray(NameValuePair[]::new);
460   }
461
462   /**
463    * Gets the first part with the given name.
464    *
465    * <p>
466    * Part name comparison is case sensitive by default.
467    *
468    * @param name The part name.
469    * @return The first matching part, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not found.
470    */
471   public Optional<NameValuePair> getFirst(String name) {
472      for (var i = 0; i < size(); i++) {
473         var x = get(i);
474         if (eq(x.getName(), name))
475            return o(x);
476      }
477      return oe();
478   }
479
480   /**
481    * Gets the last part with the given name.
482    *
483    * <p>
484    * Part name comparison is case sensitive by default.
485    *
486    * @param name The part name.
487    * @return The last matching part, or {@link Optional#empty()} if not found.
488    */
489   public Optional<NameValuePair> getLast(String name) {
490      for (var i = size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
491         var x = get(i);
492         if (eq(x.getName(), name))
493            return o(x);
494      }
495      return oe();
496   }

504   public String[] getValues(String name) {

738   /**
739    * Adds or replaces the part(s) with the same name.

741    * <p>
742    * If no part with the same name is found the given part is added to the end of the list.

750   public PartList set(NameValuePair value) {

752         var replaced = false;

754            var x = get(i);
755            if (eq(x.getName(), value.getName())) {
756               if (replaced) {

758                  j--;

760                  set(i, value);

770      return this;
